:::{#exr-mse-expand}
#### Expanding the mean squared error

Write the [mean squared error](#def-mse) $\mselr{\hparam}$
in terms of $\E{\hparam^2}$, $\E{\hparam}$, and the estimand $\param$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-mse-expand}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mselr{\hparam}
&\eqdef \E{\sqf{\erf{\hparam}}}
&& \text{(definition of MSE)}\\
&= \E{(\hparam - \param)^2}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \E{\hparam^2 - 2\hparam\param + \param^2}
&& \text{(expand the binomial square)}\\
&= \E{\hparam^2} - \E{2\hparam\param} + \E{\param^2}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \E{\param^2}
&& \text{(factor the constant $2\param$ out of the middle expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2
&& \text{(the expectation of a constant is that constant)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
